messages:
Sam: Quick sync thread for Halcyon Systems EAP -> private marketplace preview + SI partner bundle. Need to align on NDA, perf plan, packaging format (operator vs vm), and announcement gating. Who's available to drive?

Leila: I can take packaging and marketplace listing. We should prefer operator bundle for GCP/AKS customers, but include a small VM image for air-gapped demos.

Omar: I'll handle the benchmark harness. Suggest three buckets: interactive chat (p99), batched embedding throughput, and long-context generation. Baselines on 4xA100 and 2xH100.

Jesse (Halcyon): Halcyon update: legal sent an NDA with one custom security appendix. We'll need Redwood sign-off + minor redlines. Also we can provide a certified helm chart and a curated container repo.

Sam: Perfect. Nina, can you coordinate legal on our side? We need to keep the announcement window no earlier than 2 weeks after listing.

Nina: On it. I'll ping counsel and push for a 48hr turnaround. Any mandatory data retention clauses we should expect?

Jesse (Halcyon): They asked for telemetry retention to be 90 days for perf metrics only. Not user data. We'll accept metric-only retention with PCA.

Leila: Packaging checklist I'm thinking:
```
- operator-bundle: yes (helm + CRD)
- vm-image: optional (qcow2)
- container-sha: required
- quickstart-runbook: 1pg + troubleshooting
- security-scan: sca + sbom
```
We'll need Halcyon to sign off on runbook content.

Omar: For perf targets propose: p99 <= 220ms (512 tokens), embeddings >= 500 req/s (batch 64), mem < 48GB for single-replica. We'll collect token-level traces and nvprof/KPIs. Also add accuracy/regression thresholds for quantized variants.

Sam: Good baseline. Add an automated eval job to the CI that runs nightly and posts deltas. ci-bot, can you create a nightly job template?

ci-bot: Created pipeline template: refs/pipelines/marketplace/eap/halcyon-nightly.yml - owners: Omar, Leila.

Jesse (Halcyon): We'll push images to partner-registry and share SHAs. ETA Tuesday. Also we can run a preflight for int8 behavior on their infra and share csv.

Nina: Legal update: counsel wants the telemetry appendix tightened. Requesting exact fields and masking policy. Jesse, can you provide a sample telemetry payload?

Jesse (Halcyon): Sharing sample now: https://halcyon.partner/samples/telemetry-spec.csv (private link). It only contains perf counters + anonymized model-id hashes.

Leila: Ops timeline proposal: Day 0: NDA signed + artifact upload. Day 1-3: packaging + security scans. Day 4-6: test-deploy in sandbox + perf runs. Day 7: quality signoff and soft-listing to private marketplace. Week 2: monitoring + joint announcement prep.

Omar: Risk note: different kernel versions on Halcyon infra caused tokenization edge-case in prior run. I'll add a matrix of kernel/runtime combos to test.

Sam: Action items recap in thread: Sam = announcement gating; Leila = packaging + listing; Omar = perf harness + CI; Nina = legal; Jesse = artifacts + telemetry sample. ci-bot created pipeline.

Jesse (Halcyon): We'll also sync with our SI integrator (Bluebeam) to prepare a deployment playbook for customers. They can assist with on-prem installs during the EAP.

Leila: Please drop the helm chart link and runbook in the shared drive. I'll start the security scans once images are live.

ci-bot: Checklist doc created: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/eap/halcyon/checklist - added Leila,Omar,Nina as editors.

Sam: Thanks everyone. Next check-in Friday 9am PT. If NDA clears earlier, we can start packaging sooner. :rocket:
file_notes: Slack thread: Halcyon Systems EAP coordination for private marketplace preview and SI bundle. Covers NDA, packaging checklist, benchmark targets, CI pipeline, telemetry spec, SI playbook, and responsibilities.
